te.lib:h-sitr: He who relieves a believer of one of the hardships of this world, Allah will relieve him of one of the hardships of the Day of Resurrection; he who makes things easy for one in difficulty, Allah will make things easy for him in this world and the Hereafter; he who conceals (the faults of) a Muslim, Allah will conceal his faults in this world and the Hereafter. Allah helps the servant as long as the servant helps his brother…
te.lib:h-mujahirin: All of my followers will be forgiven except those who sin openly…
te.lib:h-munafiq: The signs of a hypocrite are three: whenever he speaks, he lies; whenever he promises, he breaks his promise; and whenever he is entrusted, he betrays the trust.
te.lib:h-da-ma-yaribuk: Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt. Truthfulness brings tranquillity, while falsehood brings doubt.
te.lib:h-birr-ithm: Righteousness is good character, and sin is what wavers in your heart and you dislike people coming to know of it.
te.lib:h-mustashar: The one who is consulted is in a position of trust.
te.lib:h-atqan: Allah loves that when one of you does a piece of work, he does it with excellence.
te.lib:h-ajir: Give the worker his wages before his sweat dries.
te.lib:h-kullukum-rai: All of you are shepherds, and each of you is responsible for his flock…
te.lib:h-ada-dayn: Whoever takes people's money intending to repay it, Allah will repay it on his behalf; and whoever takes it intending to squander it, Allah will ruin him.
te.lib:h-matl: Delay in paying debts by a wealthy person is injustice.
te.lib:h-samh: May Allah have mercy on a man who is easy-going when he sells, when he buys, and when he asks for repayment.
te.lib:h-inzar: Whoever grants respite to someone in difficulty, or remits his debt, Allah will shade him in His shade.
te.lib:h-ghina-nafs: Wealth is not in having many possessions; rather, true wealth is the richness of the soul.
te.lib:h-kafaf: Successful is the one who has accepted Islam, has been provided with what is sufficient, and whom Allah has made content with what He has given him.
te.lib:h-amin-sirbih: Whoever among you wakes up secure in his dwelling, healthy in his body, and having his food for the day, it is as if the whole world has been gathered for him.
te.lib:h-unzuru-asfal: Look at those below you and do not look at those above you, for that is more likely to keep you from belittling Allah's favours upon you.
te.lib:h-tawakkul-tayr: If you were to rely upon Allah as He should be relied upon, He would provide for you just as He provides for the birds: they go out in the morning hungry and return in the evening full.
te.lib:h-iqilha: A man said: “O Messenger of Allah! Shall I tie it (my camel) and rely upon Allah, or leave it loose and rely upon Allah?” He said: “Tie it and rely upon Allah.”
te.lib:h-hatab: It is better for any of you to take a rope, bring a bundle of firewood on his back and sell it, so that Allah saves his face because of it, than to ask people, whether they give him or refuse him.
te.lib:h-kafil-yatim: I and the one who looks after an orphan will be like this in Paradise — and he pointed with his index and middle fingers.
te.lib:h-armala: The one who strives for the widow and the poor is like one who fights in the cause of Allah, or one who prays all night and fasts all day.
te.lib:h-la-tahqiranna: Do not consider any act of kindness insignificant, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
te.lib:h-anfauhum: The most beloved of people to Allah are those who are most beneficial to people…
te.lib:h-khayrukum-ahlih: The best of you is the best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family.
te.lib:h-akmal-iman: The most complete of the believers in faith is the one with the best character, and the best of you are those who are best to their wives.
te.lib:h-la-yafrak: A believing man should not hate a believing woman; if he dislikes one of her traits, he will be pleased with another.
te.lib:h-radiya-ghadba: “I know when you are pleased with me and when you are angry with me… When you are pleased with me, you say: ‘No, by the Lord of Muhammad’, and when you are angry, you say: ‘No, by the Lord of Ibrahim.’” She said: “Yes, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah, I leave nothing but your name.”
te.lib:h-mataa: This world is an enjoyment, and the best enjoyment of this world is a righteous woman.
te.lib:h-dhat-din: A woman is married for four things: her wealth, her lineage, her beauty and her religion. So choose the one who is religious, may your hands be rubbed with dust (i.e. may you prosper).
te.lib:h-tardawna: When someone whose religion and character you are pleased with proposes to you, then marry (your daughter) to him. If you do not do so, there will be turmoil in the land and widespread corruption.
te.lib:h-shabab: O young men, whoever among you can afford to marry should marry, for it lowers the gaze and guards chastity; and whoever cannot, should fast, for it will be a shield for him.
te.lib:h-thalatha-awn: There are three whom it is a right upon Allah to help: the one who strives in the cause of Allah, the slave who has a contract to buy his freedom and intends to pay, and the one who marries seeking chastity.
te.lib:h-rughm: “May his nose be rubbed in dust, then may his nose be rubbed in dust, then may his nose be rubbed in dust!” It was said: “Who, O Messenger of Allah?” He said: “The one who finds his parents in old age, one or both of them, and does not enter Paradise (by serving them).”
te.lib:h-rida-walid: The Lord's pleasure is in the parent's pleasure, and the Lord's anger is in the parent's anger.
te.lib:h-asma-umm: Asma' said: My mother came to me while she was a polytheist… I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: “My mother has come wishing (for my kindness); shall I keep ties with her?” He said: “Yes, keep ties with your mother.”
te.lib:h-sila-rizq: Whoever would like his provision to be increased and his life to be prolonged, let him keep the ties of kinship.
te.lib:h-mal: A man said: “O Messenger of Allah, I have relatives with whom I keep ties but they cut me off; I treat them well but they treat me badly; I am patient with them but they behave foolishly towards me.” He said: “If you are as you say, it is as if you are feeding them hot ashes, and you will continue to have a supporter from Allah against them as long as you remain like this.”
te.lib:h-adl-awlad: Fear Allah and be just between your children.
te.lib:h-yarham-saghir: He is not one of us who does not show mercy to our young and does not recognise the honour of our elders.
te.lib:h-rahimun: The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One above the heavens will be merciful to you.
te.lib:h-walad-salih: When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: an ongoing charity, knowledge that is benefited from, or a righteous child who prays for him.
te.lib:h-kalima-lil-ahl: …You will not spend anything seeking the Face of Allah except that you will be rewarded for it, even the morsel of food you put in your wife's mouth.
te.lib:h-ajaban: How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all his affairs are good, and this is for no one except the believer: if something good happens to him, he is grateful, and that is good for him; and if something bad happens to him, he is patient, and that is good for him.
